_comment: Operator-editable mission defaults. Loaded by main.py via --config (default path: this file). Override individual fields freely; unknown fields are ignored. To use the GA-tuned weights from outputs/ga/best_params.json instead, pass --use-ga (or --params PATH).
_comment_line_command_map: IR code -> [left_duty, right_duty]. Keep the normal map soft and forward-biased so the chassis does not pivot in place or chatter audibly when the IR code flips. Code 7 is centered for the Freenove V2 sensor behavior seen on the real robot.
_comment_line_steer_limit: Max change in either wheel duty per tick. Smooths bang-bang transitions so a single noisy IR flip cannot slam the chassis sideways in one tick. Keep it below the vendor turn swings but above crawl speed so the robot still recovers promptly.
_comment_line_recovery: If the line is not visible at startup, move forward briefly to put the IR bar over the tape. If the line is lost after it was seen, backtrack briefly before a bounded sweep.
_comment_carry_obstacle: After a successful pickup the ultrasonic still sees the held ball at ~5-10cm. Suppress obstacle detection for `carry_obstacle_grace_s` after pickup completes, and treat anything closer than `carry_min_obstacle_cm` as the ball itself (not an obstacle).
